iPhone 18 Pro Spatial Audio may add tracks that do not decode; they are left out and track 1 stays what every build played
Vision mouth activity fails on profiles, small faces in wide shots, beards and hands; SW-S3 gates SW8
Four live 4K decodes may exceed the Mac's decoders; SW-S2 (c) sets the viewer's live cells
Shared toll files (op_table.rs 374/400, AppDelegate+Menus.swift 554, ProjectSnapshot.swift 1,454) take rows from every bet; tolls must land in CJ0
samples_needed: S-POD-2CAM: 10–15 min of two people talking, GH5 on one and iPhone 18 Pro on the other (4K), a mic per person (separate recorder files or two OBS tracks), a clap at the start, with short replies, laughter and talking over; a third wide angle if possible (second phone or the Mac camera via Frame Job's recorder). Measures SW-S4, JOB-51, SW-S2 on real codecs, SW-S3's truth
S-POD-SPLIT: the same kind of conversation on a wireless kit recording both people into one camera's stereo track (left/right), if the owner has one. Measures SW6
S-POD-1MIC: the same conversation with one mic between the two people and the two cameras. Measures SW-S3 and SW8
S-OBS: an OBS screen recording with the mix on track 1, a mic on track 2 and desktop on track 3, as .mkv and as Hybrid MP4. Measures SW3 and SW5
S-IPHONE-SPATIAL: a short iPhone 18 Pro clip with Spatial Audio on. Measures SW-S1 (f)
S-RECORDER: a multitrack file from a recorder or mixer (RØDECaster Pro II, Zoom F/H-series multitrack, MixPre), if owned. Measures SW6

Synthetic stand-ins made by the proofs: F-TURNS (two macOS say voices on a scripted turn table, mixed with set bleed and noise, three colour-card cameras with frame counters), F-MULTITRACK (MOV/MP4/MKV with three audio tracks, one at 44.1 kHz), F-POLY (6-channel 24-bit WAV with/without layout, 6-channel AAC), F-SPLIT (one voice per side with bleed), F-4K (10-min 3840×2160 H.264 100 Mb/s, HEVC Main 10, ProRes 422 HQ at 29.97/59.94)

phases.title: Copy pieces to a track, and Switch Angle
phases.gets: Clip ▸ Switch Angle ▸ re-picks the camera for one shot, in sync, as one undo step; agents get copy_pieces {clip, track, ranges, video?, audio?}, a piece being exactly the middle of two splits
questions_for_owner: Keys for Switch Angle now (⌥1–⌥9)? Recommended: no; bare 1–9 arrive with the Angle Viewer in SW9b.
Should a re-picked shot keep its own video settings (a punch-in, a grade)? Recommended: no (SW-14); the guide says to re-apply them.

phases.title: Switch by Speaker, a microphone per person
phases.gets: Clip ▸ Switch by Speaker… over synced cameras and mics writes a front Program track of picture-only pieces (one undo step): each mic judged against its own speech level and floor (bleed), the wide during crosstalk, a minimum shot, short replies ignored, cameras hidden and their scratch sound muted, mics untouched; tool switch_by_speaker with apply:false to preview the shots
files_touched: core/src/evaluate.rs (only if SW-S2 (a) fails: alternate a track's adjacent clips of different media over two composition tracks)
questions_for_owner: Write a Program track (SW-10) rather than cutting the camera tracks in place? Recommended: the program track (fewer clips, ordinary rolls and re-picks).
Accept the defaults — minimum shot 2 s, cut 0.2 s before speech, wide after 1 s of crosstalk — as SW-S4 tunes them? Recommended: yes.
Offer wide_after (a cut to the wide during a long monologue)? Recommended: offered, off by default.
Cut to the wide on laughter once Find Clips' Sound Analysis cache exists? Recommended: not in SW2; a candidate issue after FC.

phases.title: Every audio track of a file, played
phases.gets: A multi-track file imports with every audio track listed (media.audio_streams); the Sound tab's Source section picks the track a clip plays (source.stream, set_audio_source); playback, export, the 48 kHz copy, speed-ramp, isolation, voice and reverse renders all read that track; a clip on another track says it is not measured yet
decisions_amended: SY-23 (the 48 kHz copy keyed by file AND stream; SW-32)
SR-12 (a) ramp render name carries the stream (SW-33)
AU-52 isolated render name carries the stream (SW-33)
AU-144 voiced render name carries the stream (SW-33)
questions_for_owner: Which track plays by default? Recommended: track 1, which every build plays today and OBS uses for its mix.

phases.title: Every audio track of a file, measured
phases.gets: A clip on any track has its own waveform, loudness, speech, sync features and transcript; Normalize, Enhance Voice, Match Audio, Duck by Speech, Remove Silences, Synchronize Audio, captions, get_transcript, detect_fillers and Switch by Speaker read the track the clip plays; speech spans persisted per source (media.audio_speech)
decisions_amended: AU-10 (loudness cache per audio source, cache/loudness/<key>.bin; SW-40)
silence.md speech-cache bullet (per-source cache, cache/speech/<key>.bin; SW-40)
SY-11 and audio-sync-2's 'the pass reads the first audio track' (reads the source's stream/channel; SW-40)
R6-3 (one upload per audio source; SW-40)
AU-110 (speech spans per audio source: media.audio_speech; SW-42)
AU-116 (relink clips or clears each per-source entry; SW-42)
questions_for_owner: Measure every track at import, or only tracks a clip plays? Recommended: track 1 always and the others when a clip plays them (SW-41).

phases.title: OBS's Matroska: every audio track copied
phases.gets: An OBS .mkv with several audio tracks opens with all of them, named as in OBS; the opt-in ffmpeg step maps every audio stream
decisions_amended: #216-R (copies the first video stream and EVERY audio stream; SW-50)
#216-R's ffmpeg sentence (-map 0:a?; SW-52)

phases.title: A channel as a source
phases.gets: On a recorder's many-channel file or a wireless kit's two-person stereo track, the Source section's Channel picks one microphone as a mono source with its own waveform, loudness and speech, so Switch by Speaker can tell two people on one file apart
decisions_amended: AU-34 (a source reading one channel is mono and ignores channels; SW-62)
AU-35 (a channel source's reading is mono; SW-62)
AU-10's '>2 channels read again as two' applies to the default source only (SW-61/SW-62)
questions_for_owner: The fold for a many-channel track with no channel picked, if SW-S1 (c) finds AVFoundation's unequal? Recommended: Frame Job's equal fold at 1/√N (SW-61).

phases.title: Link groups
phases.gets: A picture and two or more sound clips move, cut, trim, slip and ripple as one linked group with the glyph and echo ring on each; older projects' pairs open as groups
decisions_amended: AU-90 (a link is a group: Clip.link replaces linked, migrated; SW-70)
AU-91
AU-92
AU-93
AU-94
AU-95
AU-96 (rules generalised to groups; SW-71)
AU-97 (glyph and echo ring on every member; SW-72)
questions_for_owner: Link groups, or unlinked sound clips that stay in sync only through ripple edits? Recommended: groups; a trimmed OBS recording would otherwise leave its tracks behind.

questions_for_owner: Include track 1 (OBS's mix) when detaching? Recommended: yes, one clip per track; the person deletes the one they do not want.
